examples.trans: Exactly three minutes remain until the dish is ready.
The chef prepared a delicious dish.

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('important').

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.
examples.trans: I told you this morning: don't rush. It's a very important question.

meanings.note: direction: идти вперёд = to go forward
colloquial, like a preposition + genitive: лезть вперёд кого-то = to push in ahead of someone
As a command.

examples.text: Вы взяточник! Вы лезете вперёд больного ребёнка.
examples.trans: You're a bribe-taker! You're pushing in ahead of a sick child.

meanings.note: 'закрывать глаза на' + accusative = to turn a blind eye to

examples.text: Я не буду закрывать на это глаза.
examples.trans: I'm not going to close my eyes to this.

examples.text: А я глаза на это закрывать не буду. Я подниму людей!
examples.trans: Well, I'm not going to close my eyes to this. I'll rally people!

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to speak, to say, to talk', paired with 'сказать'.
Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to speak, to say, to talk', paired with 'сказать'.
+ genitive.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?
Спасибо за + accusative.
+ instrumental.

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

examples.text: Ну что, довольна? Теперь новую работу искать.
examples.trans: Well, happy now? Now I have to look for a new job.

meanings.note: Question word. Core Russian adv meaning 'how; as' in everyday speech.
Как вы знаете = as you know. Core Russian adv meaning 'how; as' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: For movement; где is for location.

examples.trans: Wait, where are you two going?

With verbs: очень люблю. Core Russian adv meaning 'very, very much' in everyday speech.

побежать.gloss: to start running, to run off

meanings.en: to break into a run, to run off
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'бежать').

examples.text: Схватил собачку в парке и побежал.
examples.trans: Grab the little dog in the park and run.
The boy quickly ran off home.

examples.text: Да это легко. Схватил собачку в парке и побежал.
examples.trans: Come on, it's easy. Grab the little dog in the park and run.

meanings.note: Подожди! = wait!.

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!
Let us hold a fair duel today.
There is no point in continuing the duel now.

пошутить.gloss: to joke, to make a joke

meanings.note: Я пошутил(а) = I was only joking. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'шутить').

examples.text: Я смотрю, вы легковерный! Я же пошутила!
examples.trans: I see you're gullible! I was only joking!
Don't be offended, I was only joking.

examples.text: Может быть, шеф просто неудачно пошутил?
examples.trans: Maybe the chef just made a bad joke?

meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'должать').

examples.text: Так, операцию продолжаем. Михаил Михайлович, помогайте Лаврову.
examples.trans: Right, the operation goes on. Mikhail Mikhailovich, give Lavrov your help.

meanings.note: Простите! = sorry! forgive me!. Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to forgive; (imperative) excuse me', paired with 'прощать'.
Imperative: прости / простите. Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to forgive; (imperative) excuse me', paired with 'прощать'.
a final goodbye; plural/polite: прощайте

meanings.en: to try, to attempt, to make an effort

examples.trans: He tried to explain the situation.

examples.text: Пыталась? С бутылкой вина в руке?
examples.trans: You tried? With a bottle of wine in your hand?

разуть.gloss: to take (someone's) shoes off; разуй глаза = open your eyes

meanings.en: разуй глаза: open your eyes, look properly
meanings.note: rude colloquial idiom

examples.trans: Mom took the child's shoes off in the hallway.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word
